cato-honey-cheesecake-recipe.description: A man in a rough grey-brown tunic, face cropped at the top, pours honey from a dark pottery jug onto a round golden baked cake on a wooden board with bay leaves. Behind him a fireplace glows, with mortars, clay pots and hanging utensils on a dark wall. A rolled parchment scroll lies on the wooden table to the right. The image fills the frame edge to edge.

indian-sugar-crystallisation.description: A dim, smoky workshop. A bare-chested man in a white loincloth stirs a large black iron pan of bubbling brown liquid over an open wood fire, with a paddle. Behind him stacks of cane stalks lie against the wall. A second man crouches at right, lifting lumps of pale crystalline sugar onto a woven mat, with clay pots and a rope bundle at left. No text, frame or border is visible.

gingerbread-reaches-europe.description: Four men in dark hooded habits in a dim stone room. The bearded older monk at centre kneads pale dough on a flour-dusted wooden table, while three younger monks with shaved crowns watch closely. A stone oven with a fire glows at right. On the table sit a glazed jar, ginger roots, small bowls of spice and flour, and a knife.

nuremberg-lebkuchen-recorded.description: A bearded, weathered man in a dark smock, flour on his sleeves and hands, leans over a table and presses a dark spiced dough loaf on a carved wooden board with a geometric border. A stone hearth with a fire burns at left, a lit candle sits on the table, and round brown cakes rest on pale wafer sheets at lower right next to bowls of flour and a jar of honey. The setting is a rustic medieval kitchen with wooden paddles on the wall and stacked firewood at right. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.

candy-cane-first-handed-out.description: An elderly man in a black robe with a white ruff collar raises a finger to his lips and holds out white crook-shaped sticks to a row of young boys in white surplices with maroon collars, seated in carved wooden choir stalls. A basket of white sticks sits at his side. Tall gothic arches, dim stone, and candles surround them.

cafe-procope-gelato.description: A man with long dark curly hair in a brown embroidered vest and white lace-collared shirt leans over a marble counter, serving a small glass dish of pale iced cream. A wooden tub of ice with a scoop sits at lower left. Behind him, candlelit tables hold seated figures: a man in a grey powdered wig and a woman in a red-brown gown with a feathered hair ornament. Mirrors, wall sconces and wine glasses fill the dim room. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

bakers-chocolate-founded.description: Two men in a rustic wooden mill with a large water wheel visible through a doorway. The man on the left, in an apron and rolled shirt, pours a burlap sack of dark cocoa beans into a funnel above a big stone grinding wheel. The man on the right, in a dark coat with white hair and spectacles, holds a wooden tray with a dark chocolate cake. Gears, a wooden vat and sacks of beans fill the background. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

turkish-delight-on-sale.description: A bearded man in a cream turban and dark waistcoat stands at a wooden board in a dim workshop, cutting a pale slab with a knife while dusting it with white powder. Trays of pink and amber cubes dusted with powder sit on the counter, with copper pots, a brass scale, a fire glowing in the background, and jars on shelves behind him. The painting is an oil style and fills the whole frame with no visible border, text or signature.

sachertorte-invented.description: A young man with dark wavy hair, a white shirt, dark vest and stained canvas apron leans over a wooden table in a stone-vaulted kitchen, cutting into a dark chocolate cake on a metal pedestal stand with a knife. A glass jar of apricot jam with a spoon sits on the table beside him. A fireplace with flames glows on the left, copper pots hang on the walls, and a woman in a white cap and apron works in the background.

cadbury-chocolate-box.description: A bearded man in a dark Victorian-style suit and waistcoat leans over a wooden table, lifting the lid of an ornate heart-shaped box of chocolates lined with white paper. The lid has a painted scene of a girl in a pink dress holding a grey-and-white cat. Scattered wrappers, a pink ribbon, a knife and a warm lamp glow fill the room. The painting appears full-bleed with no visible text or frame.

fry-chocolate-easter-egg.description: An elderly man in a canvas apron and dark waistcoat, sleeves rolled, lifts the top half of a two-part metal mould on a workbench, revealing a glossy dark chocolate egg with a textured shell. Steam rises from the mould. Several finished chocolate eggs and empty moulds sit on the wooden bench, with a clamp and tools at left, a brick wall behind, and a stoneware jug of yellow daffodils at lower right. The painting is warm and dark, in an oil-painting style, and fills the frame with no visible border or text.

cracker-jack-debuts.description: A man in a flat cap and white apron stirs caramel-coated popcorn and nuts in a large wooden barrel with a scoop, and holds up a paper cone of the coated snack. Behind him, a well-dressed crowd in top hats, bowler hats and a feathered hat watches at dusk, with a white arched classical exhibition building lit up in the background. A lantern hangs in the stall and jars sit on the shelves. Oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge, with no text.

jell-o-sold-as-dessert.description: A woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a white puff-sleeved blouse and dark apron, tips a copper fluted mould over a glass pedestal plate. A red gelatin dessert wobbles out onto the plate. A stove, a stoneware jug and a dark wooden table fill a dim kitchen. Painted in an oil-painting style.

hersheys-milk-chocolate-bar.description: A moustached man in a dark three-piece suit and tie holds up a flat foil-wrapped chocolate bar, close to the viewer. Behind him, women in white caps and aprons work at long wooden tables stacking and packing brown chocolate bars on trays. The room has tall windows, hanging lamps and old machinery, and the light is warm and dim. The painting looks like an oil portrait with a visible brush texture and no frame.

oreo-introduced.description: A man in a flat cap and dark shirt with a white apron stands in a dim industrial bakery, holding a dark round sandwich cookie in both hands and looking down at it. Behind him are trays of similar dark round cookies on a conveyor and rows of cookies on racks, with old iron machinery, gears, pipes, a brick wall and a window with steam. The style is a painterly oil-like rendering, filling the whole frame with no visible text, border or frame.

eskimo-pie-patented.description: A man in a dark apron and rolled-up white shirt dips a pale rectangular bar on a holder into a copper pot of dark melted chocolate, steam rising. A boy in a flat cap stands at a wooden counter holding a small dark round object. Behind them are shelves with glass jars of candy and an old brass cash register on the right. Warm, dim, painterly interior.

haribo-gummy-bear.description: A man in a dark grey apron dusted with white flour leans over a wooden tray of white powder, dropping small amber gummy bear shapes from his hands. Copper pots sit at the left and right edges, and a dark moody background surrounds him. The image is painted in an oil-painting style with warm lamplight on the sweets.

pavlova-created.description: A middle-aged man in a white chef's jacket and tall pleated toque leans over a kitchen counter, presenting a large meringue dish topped with cream, strawberries and passion fruit halves. Behind him a copper pot rack and cookware hang on dark walls. In a bright doorway to the left, a ballerina in a pale tutu stands on pointe. The scene is painted in dark, heavy oil brushwork.

mars-bar-launched.description: An oil-style painting of a factory interior. A large steel machine pours glossy brown mixture in thick ribbons onto a metal conveyor of rectangular bars. Women in white caps and aprons stand at the left and centre, and men in flat caps watch from the right. Copper pipes, steam and a vat fill the background. No visible text, frame or border.

kit-kat-launched.description: A woman in a white cap and white coat sits in a dim brick factory with conveyor belts and machinery behind her, unwrapping a chocolate bar. A red-wrapped bar with its silver foil partly open lies on her lap and on a wooden table, and an open metal lunch tin holding bread sits on the table beside her. The painting is in a dark, painterly oil style and has no visible text or frame.

chupa-chups-lollipop.description: A painting of a smiling boy with dark tousled hair and a knitted patterned cardigan, licking a red translucent lollipop held in his right hand. Behind him in a dim doorway, a man in a vest and apron smiles and holds the door frame. A small wooden stool in the middle ground holds a glass jar of red lollipops. The street and building walls are worn stone, lit warmly from the side in an oil-painting style.

nutella-launched.description: A woman with dark hair pulled back, in a patterned sleeveless dress, spreads a dark chocolate paste on a slice of bread with a knife. A small child with brown hair watches from beside her. In front of them on a worn wooden table are a glass jar of the same paste, a plate, a metal lid, several whole hazelnuts and some hazelnut husks. The kitchen has tiled walls, a copper pot, a window with sunlight, and a jug on the counter. The style is a warm oil painting, edge to edge.

cadbury-creme-egg-named.description: A dark, painterly still life. A brown chocolate egg is cracked open on a pewter-rimmed plate, with a runny yellow and white centre spilling out. Chocolate shards lie scattered on a wooden table, and a bunch of yellow daffodils with orange cups sits at the lower right. The background is dark brown with loose brushwork.

kinder-surprise-launched.description: A boy in a fair-isle knitted sweater leans over a wooden table in a dim, old-fashioned kitchen, cracking open a hollow brown chocolate egg. A yellow plastic capsule is visible inside the broken shell, and a small painted plastic clown figure stands on the table beside it, with foil wrapper scraps and chocolate crumbs scattered around. Shelves with jars and glassware sit in the background.

cronut-hits-new-york.description: An oil-style painting of two hands, one in a white-sleeved chef's coat, holding a sugar-dusted ring-shaped pastry that is pulled open to show flaky layers. Behind it, through a shop window, a long queue of people in winter clothes stands along a brick-fronted city street with fire escapes. The interior is dark with a metal rack on the right. No visible text, border or frame.

ben-jerrys-scoop-shop.description: An oil-style painting of a shop counter viewed from inside, with an open door on the left. Waffle cones of chocolate-chunk ice cream sit on a metal stand on a wooden counter, beside steel tubs, scoop tools and paper cups. Through the doorway is a street of old brick buildings, vintage gas pumps and 1970s-style parked cars under an overcast sky. No visible text, and no people.
